units.source_text: 源氏内大臣回家，满腹懊恼，一夜不能入睡，只管胡思乱想。

en.t: Minister Genji returned home, filled with vexation; he could not sleep all night and did nothing but brood over restless thoughts.

units.source_text: 早晨起来，叫人把格子窗打开，坐在窗前闲看早晨的雾景。

en.t: When he rose in the morning, he had someone open the lattice window and sat before it, idly gazing at the morning mist.

units.source_text: 但见霜枯的秋草之中，有许多槿花到处攀缠着。

en.t: There, among the autumn grasses withered by frost, he saw many hibiscus vines twining everywhere.

units.source_text: 这些花都已形容枯萎，颜色衰褪了。

en.t: All these flowers had already grown withered in form, and their colors had faded.

units.source_text: 他就叫人折取一枝，送给槿姬，并附信道：

en.t: He then had someone break off a branch and send it to Princess Asagao, enclosing a letter that said:

units.source_text: “昨日过蒙冷遇，教我无以为颜。

en.t: Yesterday I was treated with such coldness that I have no face left to show.

units.source_text: 你看了我狼狈归去的后影，可曾取笑？

en.t: When you saw my miserable figure retreating in confusion, did you perhaps laugh at me?
But let me ask you this first:
